title: Design System: StratAI Mirage official landing

scope.authority: Official root landing replacing the former root landing. Feature-local visual reference only; does not define styles for authenticated application screens or AI Coach delivery status. SURFACE.md records direction; canonical product definition and implementation plan retain product/status authority. Source integration does not assert remote deployment.
scope.truth: Original Spanish product copy, screenshots and Dust2 video are reused; the entry headline and camera instructions are presentation copy. The replay restores scripted pauses, progressive comments, automatic continuation and prepared questions from the original landing. Utility is illustrative. Coach IA is in development and evaluation; challenges and plans remain proposals. No automatic recommendation or real-time coaching capability is demonstrated.
scope.rasterPolicy: Existing screenshots, CT/T GLBs and video remain unmodified. No images were generated.
scope.limitations: Source-derived documentation of the official root integration. Final post-loading verification belongs to REVIEW.md. No remote launch, external Steam login, WCAG certification or low-end hardware benchmark is asserted.

motion.name: button-flight
motion.value: 3.4s cubic ease-in/out; smooth camera/target/lens join over first 24% of travel
motion.purpose: Enter A from the aerial view or return to the aerial view through explicit actions.

motion.name: camera-convergence
motion.value: 1 - Math.exp(-animationDelta(delta) * 3.5); animationDelta clamps to 0–0.05s
motion.purpose: Free camera position, look target and lens-zoom convergence, excluding long demand-loop idle pauses.

motion.name: scene-demand-loop
motion.value: Wake on travel actions, drag, wheel/pinch, keyboard camera input, pointer movement, selection, resize and utility playback; continue through flight/convergence/playback, restore initial sharp DPR, then stop; Steam departure and tool-camera arcs also wake and sustain the existing demand loop until settled.
motion.purpose: Beacon breathing and dust rotation update only during active frames. Starting or resuming playback excludes the initial idle interval.

motion.name: panel-entry
motion.value: 360ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); opacity .3 to 1; perspective 1200px; translate3d(22px,0,-22px) rotateY(-2deg) to identity; origin 85% 50%
motion.purpose: Incoming tool content begins after the 120ms outgoing exit; reduced motion is immediate.

motion.name: aerial-copy-entry
motion.value: 0.65s ease-out; translateY(12px) to 0
motion.purpose: Introduce the aerial headline and entry action.

motion.name: inside-copy-entry
motion.value: 0.7s ease-out; translateY(12px) to 0
motion.purpose: Introduce arrival copy.

motion.name: primary-hover
motion.value: background .25s, transform .3s; translateY(-2px)
motion.purpose: Confirm the entry action.

motion.name: callout-hover
motion.value: background .25s, transform .25s; translate(-50%,calc(-50% - 3px))
motion.purpose: Lift the callout while retaining viewport centering.

motion.name: agents
motion.value: Static end-pose samples, then paused
motion.purpose: Natural CT/T placements without a moving replay agent.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: Immediate travel, tool panels and camera convergence; no parallax, beacon breathing, dust rotation or marker pulse. Steam veil/mark retain a 180ms opacity-only fade with a still camera.
motion.purpose: Preserve every destination. Explicit utility and replay transport remain available. Replay comments appear immediately; checkpoint pauses and reading/resume timing remain.

motion.name: illustrative-utility
motion.value: 5s
motion.purpose: User-controlled illustrative arc and smoke volume.

motion.name: original-video
motion.value: Muted autoplay attempt; playsInline; preload auto; custom pause/play, early continuation, restart and chapter controls
motion.purpose: Original Dust2 clip pauses when a timeupdate reaches 1.3s or 6s, then seeks exactly to that checkpoint for the calibrated annotation frame. Chapter selection uses the same operation; original reading delays and automatic continuation remain. Manual playback remains available when autoplay is rejected.

motion.name: replay-commentary
motion.value: 2 characters / 25ms (80 characters/s); 500ms first-message and 1500ms subsequent-message lead-ins; 6000ms context and 8000ms decision reading windows; 3000ms automatic resume delay
motion.purpose: Original Spanish script and timing constants. Chapter reselection refreshes analysis timers; closure and restart cancel pending work. End state retains the original summary and three prepared questions, with a 1s response delay.

motion.name: original-replay-marker-pulse
motion.value: 1.5s infinite ease-out; scale(1) / opacity 1 to scale(1.5) / opacity 0
motion.purpose: Original annotation ring pulse. OS preference and the existing footer reduced-motion toggle disable animation, leaving the ring and label visible.

motion.name: tool-exit
motion.value: 120ms ease-in; opacity to 0; perspective(1200px) translate3d(-12px,0,-16px) rotateY(1deg)
motion.purpose: Outgoing panel is inert and pointer-disabled; latest request replaces pending switch, outside closure/Escape cancels it.

motion.name: transition-ease
motion.value: 1 - (1 - clamp(progress,0,1))^3
motion.purpose: Shared cubic-out camera deceleration for Steam departure and tool transitions.

motion.name: tool-camera
motion.value: 560ms; live pose to existing tool endpoint, side arc sin(pi*ease)*.85*direction and Y lift sin(pi*ease)*.35; zoom and utility view offset interpolate
motion.purpose: Camera changes immediately on destination selection, before incoming content mounts; existing authored endpoints and final utility projection are preserved.

motion.name: steam-entry-camera
motion.value: 1100ms; live pose to [-1,17,31], look target [4.5,.35,25], zoom 1.8; X arc -1.2*sin(pi*ease), Y arc +1.4*sin(pi*ease); projection offset to zero
motion.purpose: Primary same-tab Steam activation departs through the current scene, then navigates once to the existing Steam endpoint.

motion.name: steam-ui-fade
motion.value: opacity 180ms ease-out
motion.purpose: Fade header, overlays, footer and camera controls; disable them and hide 3D destination beacons during entry.

motion.name: steam-veil
motion.value: 1100ms ease-out; opacity 0 at 0%, .08 at 35%, .86 at 75%, 1 at 100%; wordmark hidden through 30%, visible from 60%
motion.purpose: Existing World Teal veil and centered StratAI connection status cover the handoff.

motion.name: steam-soft-entry
motion.value: 180ms ease-out opacity-only; no camera movement
motion.purpose: Reduced motion, unavailable 3D or active normal flight; direct native fallback link remains at handoff.

accessibility.focus: 2px solid var(--mint), offset 5px; native FAQ summaries use offset 2px; stage uses inset offset -4px.
accessibility.panel: Labelled nonmodal aside. Close button receives focus; close button, Escape or an outside pointerdown closes; captured connected trigger regains focus, with first dock button as fallback. Capture-phase document pointerdown listener is removed on cleanup; interior controls and direct dock switching remain available. Direct dock/header/pin destinations bypass outside dismissal for one-click switching; outgoing panels are inert and aria-hidden. Escape/outside close cancels pending switches; selecting the same tool preserves the mounted replay.
accessibility.screenshot: Native showModal dialog with labelled original screenshot, focused close button and Escape handling that does not close the underlying panel.
accessibility.navigation: Skip link; five labelled dock destinations and world callouts; aria-pressed selection; journey and flight status regions. Information navigation uses pressed-state buttons. No journey rail is mounted.
accessibility.media: Named custom play/pause, continue, restart and chapter controls; muted inline autoplay with manual fallback and retry on load error. Status region and polite additions-only message log; static replay reference uses native details/summary. Prepared follow-up questions are available at clip end. Original annotation rings and labels are decorative, aria-hidden and pointer-events none; the current script commentary supplies their context.
accessibility.motion: OS preference initializes and updates the footer-controlled reduced-motion state. Tool panels/camera are immediate in reduced motion; Steam retains a 180ms opacity-only connection fade.
accessibility.fallback: Existing Mirage radar, reload and feature-access actions after a scene exception.
accessibility.limitations: Implemented mechanisms documented from source; not WCAG certification.
accessibility.camera: Focusable named stage: arrows pan, Shift-arrows rotate, +/minus zoom and R resets. On-screen zoom/reset/aerial actions have names. Arrival focuses the stage if no panel is open. Panel close restores the captured connected trigger.
accessibility.steamEntry: Normal same-tab primary activation only; native modifier/middle/new-tab links remain. Named connection section receives focus; underlying stage/UI are inert and aria-hidden. Escape cancels before handoff and restores trigger focus. Persisted pageshow clears state on Back; unmount clears timer. Blocked navigation leaves the same direct Steam href and a return button.
accessibility.loading: Full-screen status and progress with native existing-href Steam link, same onLogin handler, feature access while loading and retry on load errors. Underlying stage/UI inert and aria-hidden until ready or explicit feature access; loading controls inert/aria-hidden during Steam handoff.

responsiveTypography.source: world.css, content.css and exploration.css, with higher-specificity scoped productPresentation.css rules for tool and replay presentation

display.shortNarrowMobile: 60px; final narrow override wins over the earlier 40px short-mobile rule

overview.arrival: End of 3.4-second button-led flight; reduced motion arrives immediately.

adaptiveDpr.initial: Device pixel ratio bounded by dpr [1, 1.5]
adaptiveDpr.condition: Below 30 FPS across at least 30 sustained active frames and 2 seconds; idle time and isolated interactions do not lower resolution.
adaptiveDpr.settled: Restore initial sharp DPR on transition out of motion/playback, render the final sharp frame, then sleep. Reuse the measured moving DPR on the next interaction.

rendering.frameloop: demand; explicit baseline benchmark uses always
rendering.shadowUpdates: Cached static map; automatic updates disabled, refreshed when the map is ready or LOD switches.

decoderWorkers.ownership: KTX worker pool is owned above Suspense and disposed on unmount.
decoderWorkers.meshopt: Existing decoder supplied by Drei; current map uses Meshopt, not Draco. Existing agent Draco decoding is unchanged.

rendering.lighting: Own web lighting; native geometry, UV and textures. CS2 shaders/blends/lightmaps are not fully reproduced.

callouts.desktop: Projected anchors with separated candidate slots and SVG leaders; centers clamp x100 to width-100. Coach prefers 130px drop, others 65px. Label bounds avoid the complete camera-guidance/control exclusion region and the introduction.
callouts.mobile: Stats/Replay paired at lowerRow=min(455,height-355); Coach left at min(315,lowerRow-62); Mapa right at min(245,coachRow-65); Retos centered at min(530,height-307). Rows reserve the static T silhouette and camera guidance at short narrow sizes.
callouts.limitations: Specific to these five callouts; not a generic collision solver.

cameraControlsExclusion.purpose: Reserve the complete guidance, controls and surrounding gap; check full label bounds, not centers only.

asset.geometry: Native A rendered attributes, every face and winding preserved through lossless Meshopt. Only distant/background geometry is simplified and distant attributes have reduced precision.
asset.lod: Shared-texture site_high/site_distant alternatives; enter high below 68 scene units, remain high until 78. Full A remains active throughout close exploration.
asset.foliage: Wind/variation COLOR_0 is excluded from PBR tint to avoid red/black foliage. Native image content, alpha masks and materials remain.
asset.transcoder: Local Basis Embind closures with unchanged WASM preserve existing CSP without unsafe-eval; 500 images, 14,163 mip/BC1/BC3/BC7 comparisons and 359,024,480 decoded bytes match stock codec.
asset.productionGate: Real low-end/mobile hardware, compression-format fallback and slow-network testing remain unverified. No faster initial-load or universal FPS claim.

performance.measurement: Retained local Brave exploration resource snapshots. Format/buffer estimates and draw counters, not driver-reported total VRAM or low-end hardware FPS. Frame-timing sample count is zero.
performance.tradeoff: Native A and larger near textures increase download from rejected 31,839,476 bytes to 71,413,376 bytes. Lower estimated storage than the original baseline; not a faster initial-load claim. GPU format fallback can change memory savings.

historicalOptimization.status: Rejected globally simplified pass; EXPLORATION.md supersedes its current-behavior and budget statements.

nonUtilityDesktop.condition: width > 760 and selected is not utility

utility.purpose: Frame the full illustrative arc and smoke in the remaining left scene area.
utility.occlusionSource: sceneLayout.js: utilityPanelOcclusion(width), mirroring productPresentation.css panel widths and content.css right gutters.
utility.clear: clearViewOffset on leaving utility, or when utilityPanelOcclusion returns zero in mobile layout.
utility.fixedTargetOffset: The +3 sideways target offset does not apply to utility.

featureFraming.restore: Manual navigation values stay saved while a feature uses authored framing; close returns to that exploration view.
featureFraming.transition: Immediate destination-camera change over a 560ms cubic-out short arc, with live start pose and interpolated zoom/projection offset; reduced motion is immediate. Endpoints and utility final offset remain as documented.

navigation.yaw: Original overview yaw offset -0.2 to +0.06 radians

safetyCheck.limitation: Sampled source-geometry check including cursor offsets; not a general-purpose runtime collision engine.

envelope.type: Coupled asymmetric ellipsoid: target X/Z, yaw, elevation and spare dolly distance share one norm. Independent extrema cannot combine; actual range is smaller than absolute limits.
envelope.normalization: Scale offsets and nonnegative spare distance by 1 / max(1, hypot(normalized offsets, spareDistance / 2.5))

framingCheck.coverage: 90% horizontal / 80% vertical; opaque source geometry, both faces
framingCheck.limitation: Opaque double-sided source-ray proxy, not a rendered-image verdict. Small source gaps remain at wide zoom.

After that correction: focused 10 files / 46 tests passed, including coupled-camera and five-size exclusion regressions. Root build and final isolated build passed. playbackVerification.status: Historical, before exact checkpoint seeking and blue-ball coordinate calibration.

implementation.entryComponent: App.jsx lazy-imports ./features/landing-world at public route /. Feature index.js owns ordered scoped styles and exports LandingWorld. Optional standalone main.jsx imports that same index.
implementation.travel: Explicit actions start flight. Feature actions can enter A before opening a panel. No document-scroll journey, scroll spacer, scroll hint or rail is mounted.

inputs.zoom: wheel or pinch; focused-stage +/minus; on-screen zoom buttons
inputs.aerial: brand, header return or Volver al aire

implementation.gestureOwnership: Stage touch-action none; wheel over stage zooms. Open panels disable stage gestures and keep native body scrolling.
implementation.panelState: Keep manual navigation while a product feature temporarily uses authored framing; closing restores the manual exploration view. Reset restores authored A navigation. Outside pointerdown uses a capture-phase document listener with cleanup; close-button/Escape, direct tool switching, focus restoration and replay teardown remain available.
implementation.scope: Official application root landing replaces the former root landing; optional standalone remains secondary. No remote deployment is implied. Auth backend, callback, protected routing, AI Coach contracts, app dependencies and complete demo pipeline are preserved.
implementation.cameraEnvelope: Coupled asymmetric ellipsoid across pan/yaw/elevation/spare distance with a 17-unit floor and 2.5 spare-dolly radius; lens zoom remains 0.8 to 2.1.
implementation.calloutClearance: Complete camera-guidance/control exclusion area, including mobile and short narrow layouts; retains world-anchor leaders.
implementation.header: Global header has no lower border. Local panel, Coach and disclosure dividers remain.

productPresentation.genericPanel: Base width is the feature-panel frontmatter component token; desktop top 109px, right 34px, bottom 118px. At >=1900px: min(1200px,62vw), top 120px, right 60px. At 761..1100px: 64vw, right 26px.
productPresentation.screenshot: Original proportions with object-fit contain; desktop max-height min(55svh,620px); mobile no height cap. Native enlargement retained.
productPresentation.replayPanel: Centered; base width is the replay-panel frontmatter component token; max-width 1960px; left/right 48px, top 96px, bottom 98px; edges 24px at <=1100px.
productPresentation.replayDesktop: Video/Coach grid; video width capped by max(220px,100svh - 535px) times original 16/9 ratio, maximum 66%; Coach minimum 300px, maximum height max(340px,100svh - 451px). At <=1100px: minimum Coach 260px and gap 16px.
productPresentation.mobile: At <=760px all panels left/right 10px, top 86px, bottom 126px. Video then Coach in ordinary scroll flow; no sticky video. Coach min-height 330px with no overall max-height; message log max-height 330px.
productPresentation.reference: Original replay screenshot and capability list remain reachable in native details below the live demo.

replayMarkers.source: Current LandingDemo.jsx and productPresentation.css retain original ring/label styling. Former chatDemo.css and ChatDemoSection.jsx are historical sources preserved in before-migration.zip. Fixed coordinates remain calibrated from blue-ball centroids in the native 1920x1080 source clip.
replayMarkers.authority: User-pinned restoration of the original red player circle and yellow teammate treatment; not a new destination palette.
replayMarkers.ringBorder: 3px solid, circular; exact player/teammate color primitives live in DESIGN.md frontmatter.
replayMarkers.alignment: 60px anchor translated -50% on each axis; ring fills anchor; label bottom -28px, left 50%, translated -50% horizontally.
replayMarkers.behavior: Shown for the active scripted analysis insight only; original labels and Eye icon. Decorative and pointer-transparent. beginAnalysis pauses and seeks exactly to the 1.3s or 6s calibration frame, including chapter selection. Critical corta has a phase-scoped position. Original 16:9 media, reading delays, automatic continuation and layout remain.
replayMarkers.reducedMotion: Existing OS and footer-toggle rules disable the ring pulse.
replayMarkers.limitation: Fixed annotations calibrated for two scripted pause frames, not continuous gameplay tracking or player identity. Pulse is defined by source CSS; static screenshots do not demonstrate animation.
replayMarkers.mobileLabel: At max-width 760px, B and critical-B labels use left:0; transform:none relative to their 60px anchor, keeping the full label within the video. Desktop labels stay horizontally centered; circle coordinates do not change.

toolTransitions.source: LandingWorld.jsx, ProductPanel.jsx, sceneTransitions.js, transitions.css and WorldScene.jsx
toolTransitions.state: Requested destination drives the camera immediately; visible selected content is separate. Outgoing exit 120ms, incoming entrance 360ms, tool-camera arc 560ms. Latest request clears stale timer; Escape/outside close cancels pending switches; same-tool activation preserves mounted replay.
toolTransitions.dismissal: Dock/header/pin destination buttons bypass outside pointer dismissal; ordinary outside close remains. Outgoing panels inert/aria-hidden/pointer-disabled.
toolTransitions.camera: Existing tool endpoints and final utility projection offset preserved; interpolate zoom/offset along the short authored arc.
toolTransitions.runtime: Existing Fiber camera/useFrame/demand loop, memoized vectors; no new renderer or application dependency.

steamEntry.source: useSteamEntry.js, sceneTransitions.js, transitions.css, LandingWorld.jsx and WorldScene.jsx
steamEntry.href: Existing STEAM_LOGIN = API_URL + /auth/steam/login; root landing is replaced, while authentication endpoint/callback/pipeline are unchanged.
steamEntry.activation: Normal same-tab primary link click starts one 1100ms departure, or 180ms opacity-only when reduced motion/3D unavailable/normal flight active. Native modifiers, middle button and target=_blank bypass interception.
steamEntry.visibility: UI fades 180ms and becomes inert/aria-hidden; destination callouts disabled, 3D beacons hidden.
steamEntry.lifecycle: Escape cancels before handoff and restores trigger focus; persisted pageshow resets Back state; unmount clears timer; repeated activation cannot queue multiple navigation calls.
steamEntry.handoff: Navigate existing href once after duration. Blocked navigation retains an ordinary same-href link and return button.
steamEntry.verificationLimit: Auth route intercepted with local test response; no real user Steam session authenticated.

styleIsolation.root: .landing-world fixed full-viewport root, 100svh, overflow hidden, own 16px font base.
styleIsolation.selectors: Feature CSS, former root resets, focus/scrollbar styles and reduced-motion rules mechanically scoped to .landing-world. No global html/body scroll lock; styles do not affect later routes after SPA unmount.
styleIsolation.owner: index.js imports world.css, content.css, exploration.css, productPresentation.css, transitions.css in that order. ProductPanel no longer imports CSS independently.
styleIsolation.markerLabel: Fixed 10.4px preserves the original .65rem appearance at the prior standalone 16px root, including when the app mobile root is 14px.

contentSources.migration: Original content/script moved unchanged; former components/Landing and styles/Landing removed after output/landing-official-20261016/before-migration.zip. Actual media and 3D files remain.

loading.actions: Conectar Steam uses existing native href and onLogin; Ver funciones mientras carga opens product access without waiting for 3D; errors add retry.
loading.inputState: Underlying controls inert while loading or sign-in; loading controls inert during handoff.
loading.camera: Unavailable 3D retains existing 180ms opacity-only Steam handoff.

implementation.authentication: Public root performs no session check. STEAM_LOGIN remains API_URL + /auth/steam/login. Existing SteamLoginSuccess chooses /history-code or /dashboard; RequireAuth still guards protected routes. No backend/session/pipeline contract change.
implementation.footer: ANALIZA TU PARTIDA replaces the former prototype label in the footer only.

narrative.overview:
This reference records the official StratAI landing at the public application route `/`, entered through `frontend/index.html` and the lazy feature import in `App.jsx`. It replaces the former root landing; `frontend/landing-world.html` remains an optional standalone entry. Native Mirage geometry, UVs and textures provide warm stone, blue and salmon facades against a deep teal horizon with web lighting. Compact dark navigation leaves the map visible; opening a tool gives its content a broad reading surface. Rajdhani retains the condensed game identity; Inter carries the original Spanish landing copy and product information.

The direction and composition remain in [SURFACE.md](SURFACE.md). This reference governs the landing feature, without extending its styles to authenticated application screens. The official root integration is a source change, not a remote deployment. The [canonical product definition](../../../../docs/AI_COACH_PRODUCT_DEFINITION.md) governs product promises; the [implementation plan](../../../../docs/AI_COACH_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md) governs delivery status. Screenshots and the scripted demo do not establish automatic coaching availability or production readiness.
keyCharacteristics: Native textured Mirage and web lighting provide real scene depth.
Five labeled destinations also remain available in the bottom dock.
Larger tool panels reuse original Spanish copy and screenshots; a wide replay pairs the original Dust2 video with its scripted, progressive Coach commentary.
A static CT on A and T on stairs ground the final open camera view.
Button-led flight hands over to bounded pan, rotation and zoom in native-detail A.
Demand rendering restores the initial sharp pixel ratio after movement settles.
Tool changes coordinate a short camera arc with panel exit and entry; Steam sign-in departs through the existing Mirage scene before the existing authentication handoff.
Coach IA remains in development and evaluation; challenges and plans remain proposals.

rules.name: The Destination Rule
rules.body: Preserve the five destination colors together with text labels, icons and explicit selection states.

rules.name: The Replay Marker Rule
rules.body: Preserve the original red player ring and yellow teammate ring and their labels; center them on the calibrated blue-ball positions at the exact 1.3s and 6s pause frames.

rules.name: The User-Controlled Motion Rule
rules.body: Keep every destination available with reduced motion and preserve explicit playback controls for media and illustrative utility.

rules.name: The Cancellable Handoff Rule
rules.body: Keep Steam entry cancellable before handoff, preserve the native sign-in href and modifier-click behavior, and keep reduced-motion tool changes immediate.

dos: Do apply this reference to the official root landing feature and keep its styling scoped to that feature.
Do preserve the five destination colors together with labels, icons and explicit selection states.
Do keep the bottom feature controls, keyboard focus path and reduced-motion destinations available.
Do retain original Spanish copy and media with the Coach development, retos proposal and scripted-demo disclosures.
Do preserve the recorded native-map provenance and original media hashes.
Do preserve the original red/yellow marker styling and the calibrated coordinates at the exact scripted pause frames.
Do keep Steam entry cancellable before handoff and preserve native links and reduced-motion alternatives.
donts: Don't extend landing-specific styles to other application routes or treat this reference as AI Coach delivery-status evidence.
Don't present screenshots or scripted comments as demonstrated automatic coaching.
Don't imply that illustrative utility validates gameplay physics.
Don't require pointer parallax or ambient animation to understand or operate the landing.
Don't replace native map depth with a generated background while claiming the implemented 3D behavior.
Don't infer production readiness from local rendering or the compressed GLB size.
